test_title: PYST 24: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 7th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Sunanda ______ me of my school friend whom I haven’t seen for many years.
solution: The correct answer is '**reminds**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**reminds**'. • It means 'to cause somebody to remember somebody/something'. (किसी को किसी व्‍यकि्त या वस्‍तु की याद दिलाना) • *Example: Can you **remind** me of your address?* • In the given context '**remind someone of**' is **a phrasal verb.** • It means 'to cause (someone) to remember (something)'. • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.** **Correct Sentence:__** *Sunanda **reminds** me of my school friend whom I haven't seen for many years.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **recalls**: to remember something (a fact, event, action, etc.) from the past. [अतीत की कोई बात (तथ्‍य, घटना, क्रिया आदि) याद करना] • **remembers**: to have somebody/something in your mind or to bring somebody/something back into your mind. (व्यक्ति या वस्‍तु का ध्‍यान रहना या उसे याद करना ) • **recollects**: to remember something, especially by making an effort. [किसी बात को याद करना (विशेषतः कुछ प्रयास के पश्‍चात)] 3a:Tbd4, The correct answer is** 'has escaped from'.**
